chunks: How shall it be when We call witnesses from each and every people and call you as witness over them?
ai.seo_question: Who are the witnesses called on the Day of Judgment according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'witness from every nation' is often interpreted as the Prophet of each respective community who attests to the delivery of the divine message, while the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) serves as the universal witness (Shahid) over all humanity, confirming the finality of his mission. This verse underscores the concept of Tawatur (mass transmission) of revelation and positions the Prophet as the ultimate guarantor of truth on the Day of Judgment, a role that extends to the Imams as his successors in conveying the message. The imagery highlights both the accountability of each nation and the comprehensive authority of the Prophet over the entire ummah.
